mode.description:
Operation mode. text_to_image: generate from text prompt only. image_edit: modify
existing image(s) with text instruction. image_translate: translate text in image
preserving layout.

prompt.description:
For text_to_image: image description prompt. For image_edit: editing instruction
(e.g. 'convert to watercolor style'). Not used for image_translate.

image_urls.description:
Input image URL(s). For image_edit: 1-3 image URLs to edit/combine. For
image_translate: exactly 1 image URL. Not used for text_to_image.

size.description:
Output image size (width*height). Common options: '1024*1024' (square), '2048*2048'
(hi-res square), '2688*1536' (16:9 landscape), '1536*2688' (9:16 portrait), '2368*1728'
(4:3). Total pixels: 512*512 to 2048*2048. Default: '1024*1024'.

negative_prompt.default: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，画面过饱和
negative_prompt.description:
Things to avoid in the generated image. Default: '低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，画面过饱和'.
Only for text_to_image and image_edit modes.

prompt_extend.description:
Enable intelligent prompt rewriting for better results. Set to false when you
need precise control. Default: true.

seed.description:
Random seed for reproducibility. Fix seed while iterating prompts to compare changes.
Omit for random.

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-4). Default: 1.

source_lang.description:
Source language for image_translate mode. Options: zh, en, ja, ko, fr, de, es,
ru, etc. Default: zh.

target_lang.description:
Target language for image_translate mode. Options: zh, en, ja, ko, fr, de, es,
ru, etc. Default: en.

output_dir.description:
Directory to save generated images. If provided, downloads images to this
directory. If omitted, returns URLs only (valid 24h).

mode.description:
Generation mode. text_to_video: pure text prompt → video (wan2.7-t2v). first_frame:
image + text prompt → video starting from that image (wan2.7-i2v). first_last_frame: two
images + text prompt → video interpolating between them (wan2.7-i2v).

prompt.description:
Video description prompt. Use cinematic language: camera movements (pan, zoom,
tracking), temporal dynamics (gradually, suddenly, slowly), style keywords (cinematic,
documentary, vintage). Avoid: multi-person interactions, complex gestures, text content.
Required for all modes.

first_frame_url.description:
URL of the first frame image. Required for first_frame and first_last_frame
modes. Must be a publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL.

last_frame_url.description:
URL of the last frame image. Required for first_last_frame mode only. Must
be a publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL.

size.description:
Video size preset. For text_to_video this selects the output size; for image-to-video
it selects only the resolution tier, while aspect ratio and exact dimensions follow the
first frame. Options: '1280*720' (16:9 landscape), '720*1280' (9:16 portrait), '960*960'
(square), and '1920*1080' (full HD). The legacy '1024*1024' value is accepted and maps
to Wan 2.7's 960*960 output. Default: '1280*720'.

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds. Wan 2.7 accepts 2-15 seconds. Default: 5. Cost scales
linearly with duration.

negative_prompt.description:
Things to avoid in the video. Example: 'blurry, low quality, distorted
faces, watermark'. Default: empty.

prompt_extend.description: Enable intelligent prompt rewriting for better video results. Default: true.

seed.description:
Random seed for reproducibility [0, 2147483647]. Fix seed to compare prompt
variations. Default: 12345.

output_dir.description:
Directory to save the generated video. If provided, downloads video to this
directory. If omitted, returns the video URL only (valid 24h).

action.description:
Action to perform. detect: check if image meets requirements (sync and billed per
successful request; always run first). generate: create lip-sync video from image +
audio (async, billed, 5-10 min).

image_url.description:
Public URL of the portrait image. Requirements: single person, front-facing,
clear, JPG/JPEG/PNG/BMP/WEBP, resolution 400-7000px per side. Supports: portrait, half-
body, full-body, cartoon characters.

audio_url.description:
Public URL of the audio file. Required for 'generate' action only. Requirements:
WAV or MP3 format, < 15MB, < 20 seconds, must contain clear human voice, remove
background noise/music.

resolution.description:
Output video resolution. Options: '480P' (faster, cheaper) or '720P'. Default:
'480P'.

poll_interval.description:
Polling interval in seconds for async generation task. Min 5, recommended 15.
Default: 15.

poll_timeout.description:
Max time in seconds to wait for generation to complete. Typical generation
time: 5-10 minutes. Default: 700.

output_dir.description:
Directory to save the generated video. If provided, downloads video to this
directory. If omitted, returns the video URL only (valid 24h).

mode.description:
Operation mode. text_to_video: generate video from text description. image_to_video:
animate a single input image (first frame) into video. reference_to_video: generate
video with 1-9 reference images fused into the scene (use [Image 1], [Image 2] etc. in
prompt to reference each image). video_edit: modify an existing video based on text
instruction, optionally guided by reference images.

prompt.description:
Text prompt (up to 2500 Chinese chars / 5000 non-Chinese). Required for all modes
EXCEPT image_to_video (optional there). For reference_to_video: use [Image 1], [Image 2]
etc. to reference images and describe what each depicts, e.g. 'the woman from [Image 1]
runs on the beach'.

image_url.description:
Input image URL or base64 data for image_to_video mode. Required for
image_to_video. This image becomes the first frame of the generated video. Requirements:
JPEG/JPG/PNG/WEBP, width & height ≥300px, aspect ratio 1:2.5~2.5:1, ≤20MB. Output video
aspect ratio follows the input image (ratio param is ignored).

video_url.description:
Input video URL for video_edit mode. Required for video_edit. Requirements:
MP4/MOV (H.264), 3-60s duration (>15s auto-truncated to first 15s), long edge ≤4096px,
short edge ≥360px, aspect ratio 1:2.5~2.5:1, ≤100MB, >8fps.

reference_image_urls.description:
Reference images for reference_to_video (1-9, required) or video_edit
(0-5, optional). For reference_to_video: each image provides a character/object to fuse
into the video. Prompt must use [Image 1], [Image 2] etc. to reference them by array
order. For video_edit: style guidance or element replacement reference. Requirements:
JPEG/JPG/PNG/WEBP, ≤20MB each. r2v: short edge ≥400px, recommend ≥720P. video_edit:
width/height ≥300px.

ratio.description:
Aspect ratio for text_to_video and reference_to_video modes. Ignored for
image_to_video (follows input image) and video_edit. Default: '16:9'.

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds for text_to_video, image_to_video, and
reference_to_video modes. Range: 3-15. Default: 5. For video_edit: duration follows
input video (≤15s).

audio_setting.description:
Audio control for video_edit mode only. 'auto': model generates/modifies
audio. 'origin': preserve original audio from input video. Default: 'auto'.

watermark.description: Whether to add watermark. Default: false.

poll_timeout.description: Max wait time in seconds. Default: 600.

output_dir.description:
Directory to save generated video. If provided, downloads video to this
directory. If omitted, returns URL only (valid 24h).

required_before_live_use: exact runtime dependency and grants readback
durable intent and no resubmit of interrupted or unknown effects
source/reference hashes, script/scene request and synthetic label
bounded download, actual output hash and full decode before acceptance

transparent_background.action: Reject alpha-required intent before submit; carry unsupported intent explicitly in the complementary durable request receipt.

reference_overflow.action: Reject before submit rather than silently drop

wan_t2v.image_modes: size aspect: only resolution tier sent; follows first image

provider_truncation.happyhorse.video_edit: Upstream docstring claim, not independently verified: input >15s is truncated to first 15s; reject whole-video requests that could lose coverage before spend.

upstream_retry.applies_to: SDK generation, async submit, detection, poll and download
upstream_retry.action: External effect guard required; submit retries may duplicate billed generation. Do not reissue timed out calls.

polling.wan_t2v: Blocking SDK call; schema has no finite poll timeout. External deadline and occupied unknown-effect state required.
polling.note: A poll iteration may exceed its overall deadline through GET timeout/retries; no upstream public cancel/resume tool.

guards.download: save_url_to_dir retries, buffers response without a byte ceiling, follows requests defaults and skips existing paths without hashing/decoding; URL/filename hash is not an artifact hash.

output_contract.upstream: MCP text content blocks, URL-only unless output_dir supplied; Error: text may appear without protocol isError
output_contract.task_id: HappyHorse/Wan-S2V success/failure/timeout text; image-translate timeout text only; synchronous image/Wan output omits task ID. Exceptions may omit a previously submitted ID.
output_contract.usage: Optional provider-reported values; never measured decode metadata. Wan printed duration/size are request-derived.
output_contract.expired_urls: Upstream docstrings claim 24h validity; actual expiry not qualified; HTTP errors become Error: text.
output_contract.complementary_receipts: Durable selected-provider submit/resume/cancel and final artifact verification remain separately unqualified; no verified complementary operator guide is bound here.
